final_answer:
The root cause is that the `onPurchaseComplete` handler in `src/checkout.js` called `flagsmith.identify(user.email)` before `trackEvent("purchase")`. That switched the identity from the `user.id` used for bucketing to the email, so Flagsmith recorded every purchase under an identity with no variant assignment. This matches the evidence: 4,210 events received, but 0 conversions for both variants.

I removed the re-identify call so the purchase is tracked under `user.id`. I haven't run the app or the experiment. The change only fixes new events, so purchases already recorded under email identities won't be attributed to a variant.
